summary: lowdb X is the strongest complete result: required semantics are covered and its 1440x900 render is readable. lowdb Y is semantically richer in its explicit adapter layers but omits required core-state/read details and its browser section is clipped. Polka X covers the required request flow and is readable, with some dense edge crossings. Polka Y has a required URL-parser/request-field omission and no supplied final image; there is no fair aggregate winner across these uneven visual conditions.
